mail/imap_uid#

IMAP message numbers and UIDs: different types, so they cannot be mixed.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let set = ImapUidSet(ImapUid((4)), ImapUid((5)), ImapUid((9)));
set.argument();                          // for UID FETCH, UID STORE …
MailboxUids(mailbox: inbox, validity: state.uid_validity(), uids: set).checked(mailbox: inbox, validity: now);

Description#

IMAP message numbers and UIDs: different types, so they cannot be mixed.

UIDs mean something only with their mailbox's UIDVALIDITY: MailboxUids keeps them together and refuses stale ones StaleImapUids. UIDs are nonzero 32-bit numbers; sets hold at most 4096 by default.
